verdict.rationale: Azure publishes an official Pricing Calculator at azure.microsoft.com/pricing/calculator. It also has public pricing pages for pay-as-you-go purchase options and free services, so a founder can estimate costs before committing. One community comment calls Azure's pricing 'opaque', but that is general sentiment rather than a concrete counter-example, so it lowers confidence and does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: evidence of individual per-service pricing pages (only page titles are evidenced), any detail on how the calculator estimates a multi-service stack, and independent or hands-on corroboration of calculator accuracy.
